citations.assessment: Tzadok reports seeing Yose ben Zimra seek permission to permit examination of firstlings. Rabbi Abba gives a competing account of the sought ruling. The passage is separate from the unlocated Yose ben Chalukah and cannot substitute for him.
The Tzadok heading’s entry directly reports the same Yoma encounter and explicitly points back here, without identifying the two names.
